chunks.heading: Health Insurance
chunks.text: All employees are covered under a group health insurance policy of INR 5,00,000 from the first day of employment. Spouse, children and parents can be added during enrollment at a nominal premium.

chunks.heading: Provident Fund
chunks.text: Both the employee and the employer contribute 12 percent of basic salary to the provident fund.
chunks.index_text: Provident Fund. Both the employee and the employer contribute 12 percent of basic salary to the provident fund.

chunks.heading: Learning Allowance
chunks.text: Each employee gets INR 30,000 per year for courses and certifications. Courses must be relevant to the role and approved by the manager.
chunks.index_text: Learning Allowance. Each employee gets INR 30,000 per year for courses and certifications. Courses must be relevant to the role and approved by the manager.

chunks.heading: Employee Referral Bonus
chunks.text: A referral bonus of INR 25,000 is paid after the referred candidate completes 3 months in the company.
chunks.index_text: Employee Referral Bonus. A referral bonus of INR 25,000 is paid after the referred candidate completes 3 months in the company.

chunks.heading: Salary Payment
chunks.text: Salaries are credited on the last working day of each month.
chunks.index_text: Salary Payment. Salaries are credited on the last working day of each month.

chunks.heading: Probation and Notice
chunks.text: The probation period is 3 months. After confirmation the notice period is 60 days.

chunks.heading: Workplace Behaviour
chunks.text: All employees must treat colleagues, clients and vendors with respect. Harassment, discrimination and bullying are strictly prohibited and may lead to termination of employment.
chunks.index_text: Workplace Behaviour. All employees must treat colleagues, clients and vendors with respect. Harassment, discrimination and bullying are strictly prohibited and may lead to termination of employment.

chunks.heading: Reporting Concerns
chunks.text: Concerns about misconduct can be reported to the Ethics Committee at ethics@zenvora.example or through the anonymous helpline 1800-555-0142. Retaliation against anyone who reports in good faith is prohibited.
chunks.index_text: Reporting Concerns. Concerns about misconduct can be reported to the Ethics Committee at ethics@zenvora.example or through the anonymous helpline 1800-555-0142. Retaliation against anyone who reports in good faith is prohibited.

chunks.heading: Reporting Concerns
chunks.text: Retaliation against anyone who reports in good faith is prohibited. The Ethics Committee acknowledges every report within 48 hours.
chunks.index_text: Reporting Concerns. Retaliation against anyone who reports in good faith is prohibited. The Ethics Committee acknowledges every report within 48 hours.

chunks.heading: Conflict of Interest
chunks.text: Employees must disclose any financial interest in a vendor, competitor or client to HR. Gifts worth more than INR 2,000 must be declined or declared.
chunks.index_text: Conflict of Interest. Employees must disclose any financial interest in a vendor, competitor or client to HR. Gifts worth more than INR 2,000 must be declined or declared.

chunks.heading: Dress Code
chunks.text: Business casual is the standard dress code on weekdays. Casual wear is allowed on Fridays. Employees meeting clients must wear formal attire.
chunks.index_text: Dress Code. Business casual is the standard dress code on weekdays. Casual wear is allowed on Fridays. Employees meeting clients must wear formal attire.

chunks.heading: Company Property and Data
chunks.text: Laptops, access cards and other company property remain the property of Zenvora. Loss, theft or misuse of company property, or any suspected data breach, must be reported to the Ethics Committee and the IT Security team without delay.
chunks.index_text: Company Property and Data. Laptops, access cards and other company property remain the property of Zenvora. Loss, theft or misuse of company property, or any suspected data breach, must be reported to the Ethics Committee and the IT Security team without delay.

chunks.heading: Confidentiality
chunks.text: Client and company information must not be shared outside the organisation without written approval. This obligation continues after employment ends.
chunks.index_text: Confidentiality. Client and company information must not be shared outside the organisation without written approval. This obligation continues after employment ends.

chunks.heading: Travel Reimbursement
chunks.text: Business travel must be approved by the reporting manager before booking. Economy class is permitted for flights under 6 hours. Hotel stays are reimbursed up to INR 6,000 per night in metro cities and INR 4,000 per night elsewhere.
chunks.index_text: Travel Reimbursement. Business travel must be approved by the reporting manager before booking. Economy class is permitted for flights under 6 hours. Hotel stays are reimbursed up to INR 6,000 per night in metro cities and INR 4,000 per night elsewhere.

chunks.heading: Meal Allowance
chunks.text: A meal allowance of INR 1,200 per day applies during business travel. Alcohol is never reimbursable.
chunks.index_text: Meal Allowance. A meal allowance of INR 1,200 per day applies during business travel. Alcohol is never reimbursable.

chunks.heading: Claim Submission
chunks.text: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense through the Finance portal with original receipts attached. Claims above INR 25,000 need approval from the department head. Reimbursement is processed within 10 working days of approval.
chunks.index_text: Claim Submission. Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense through the Finance portal with original receipts attached. Claims above INR 25,000 need approval from the department head. Reimbursement is processed within 10 working days of approval.

chunks.heading: Company Credit Card
chunks.text: Company credit cards are issued only to employees at grade L5 and above. Lost or stolen cards must be reported to the Finance team immediately so the card can be blocked.
chunks.index_text: Company Credit Card. Company credit cards are issued only to employees at grade L5 and above. Lost or stolen cards must be reported to the Finance team immediately so the card can be blocked.

chunks.heading: Passwords
chunks.text: Passwords must be at least 12 characters and include upper case, lower case, a number and a symbol. Passwords expire every 90 days and the last 5 passwords cannot be reused. Never share your password with anyone, including IT staff.
chunks.index_text: Passwords. Passwords must be at least 12 characters and include upper case, lower case, a number and a symbol. Passwords expire every 90 days and the last 5 passwords cannot be reused. Never share your password with anyone, including IT staff.

chunks.heading: Multi-Factor Authentication
chunks.text: MFA is mandatory for email, VPN and the HR portal. Use the Zenvora Authenticator app. SMS codes are not accepted.
chunks.index_text: Multi-Factor Authentication. MFA is mandatory for email, VPN and the HR portal. Use the Zenvora Authenticator app. SMS codes are not accepted.

chunks.heading: VPN Usage
chunks.text: The company VPN must be used when accessing internal systems from outside the office. Connect using the GlobalProtect client with your corporate credentials. VPN sessions disconnect after 30 minutes of inactivity.
chunks.index_text: VPN Usage. The company VPN must be used when accessing internal systems from outside the office. Connect using the GlobalProtect client with your corporate credentials. VPN sessions disconnect after 30 minutes of inactivity.

chunks.heading: Laptop and Device Rules
chunks.text: Company laptops must have disk encryption enabled and may not be used by family members. Installing unapproved software is prohibited.
chunks.index_text: Laptop and Device Rules. Company laptops must have disk encryption enabled and may not be used by family members. Installing unapproved software is prohibited.

chunks.heading: Laptop and Device Rules
chunks.text: Installing unapproved software is prohibited. If a laptop is lost or stolen, report it to the IT helpdesk at helpdesk@zenvora.example or extension 4040 within 2 hours so the device can be remotely wiped.

chunks.heading: Reporting Security Incidents
chunks.text: Phishing emails, malware alerts and suspected data breaches must be reported to security@zenvora.example immediately. Do not delete the suspicious email; use the Report Phishing button. The Security team responds within 1 hour.

chunks.text: Confidential data must not be sent to personal email accounts. USB storage devices are blocked by default.
chunks.index_text: Email and Data Handling. Confidential data must not be sent to personal email accounts. USB storage devices are blocked by default.

chunks.heading: Annual Leave
chunks.text: Full-time employees are entitled to 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave accrues at 1.5 days per month from the date of joining.
chunks.index_text: Annual Leave. Full-time employees are entitled to 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave accrues at 1.5 days per month from the date of joining.

chunks.heading: Annual Leave
chunks.text: Leave accrues at 1.5 days per month from the date of joining. Employees must submit leave requests in the HR portal at least 5 working days in advance for absences of 3 days or more.
chunks.index_text: Annual Leave. Leave accrues at 1.5 days per month from the date of joining. Employees must submit leave requests in the HR portal at least 5 working days in advance for absences of 3 days or more.

chunks.heading: Carry Forward
chunks.text: Up to 8 unused annual leave days can be carried forward to the next calendar year. Carried-forward days expire on 31 March. Leave encashment is not available except at separation.
chunks.index_text: Carry Forward. Up to 8 unused annual leave days can be carried forward to the next calendar year. Carried-forward days expire on 31 March. Leave encashment is not available except at separation.

chunks.heading: Sick Leave
chunks.text: Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per year. Sick leave cannot be carried forward. Employees must inform their manager before the start of the working day on which they are unwell.
chunks.index_text: Sick Leave. Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per year. Sick leave cannot be carried forward. Employees must inform their manager before the start of the working day on which they are unwell.

chunks.heading: Medical Documentation
chunks.text: A medical certificate from a registered doctor is required if sick leave exceeds 2 consecutive days. Certificates must be uploaded to the HR portal within 3 working days of returning to work.
chunks.index_text: Medical Documentation. A medical certificate from a registered doctor is required if sick leave exceeds 2 consecutive days. Certificates must be uploaded to the HR portal within 3 working days of returning to work.

chunks.heading: Maternity and Paternity Leave
chunks.text: Female employees are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave. Male employees receive 10 days of paid paternity leave, to be taken within 6 months of the child's birth.
chunks.index_text: Maternity and Paternity Leave. Female employees are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave. Male employees receive 10 days of paid paternity leave, to be taken within 6 months of the child's birth.

chunks.heading: Public Holidays
chunks.text: The company observes 12 public holidays per year. The holiday list is published every December on the intranet. Employees who work on a public holiday receive a compensatory day off.

chunks.heading: Eligibility
chunks.text: Employees who have completed 6 months of service may apply for hybrid work. Hybrid employees work from the office at least 3 days a week.
